qualifier: transcriptional chaperone induction and beta-cell apoptosis control
name: ER stress chaperone gene induction and beta-cell apoptosis control
rationale: Members are the transcriptional arms of the ER unfolded protein response (ATF6, ATF6B, XBP1s, ATF4, CREB3 activating chaperone genes, ER overload) and regulation of ER-stress/beta-cell apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on eIF2-kinase translational control (PERK/HRI/GCN2), IRE1/PERK regulation and mitochondrial UPR.

qualifier: downstream NF-kB activation and IL-2 production
name: Downstream antigen receptor signaling to NF-kB and IL-2
rationale: Members share positive antigen-receptor signaling downstream of TCR/BCR leading to NF-kB activation and IL-2 production, distinguishing them from confusables about proximal TCR events (CD3/ZAP-70), CD28 costimulation, co-inhibition and T cell differentiation.

qualifier: glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor, lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor metabolism with lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, and lysosomal glycoside breakdown, whereas confusables are N-glycosylation, CDG and nucleotide-sugar pathways.

qualifier: negative regulation
name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven endothelial sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are almost all negative regulation of VEGF signaling, endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis and sprouting angiogenesis, while confusables carry positive regulation, Tie2 and VEGFR2 signaling or endothelial survival and junctions.

qualifier: endolysosomal and Golgi acidification
name: Endolysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification and pH control
rationale: Members share control of intracellular compartment pH through proton transport, V-ATPase assembly and CO2 hydration in lysosome, endosome and Golgi lumens, unlike confusables centred on sodium/proton exchangers, synaptic vesicles and bicarbonate or anion transporters.

qualifier: Rac GTPases, WAVE/WASP and Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: Rac GTPase signaling to Arp2/3-driven lamellipodium formation
rationale: Members are RAC1/2/3 GTPase cycles and their activation of WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 nucleation and lamellipodium assembly, distinguishing them from CDC42/RHOG GTPase confusables and from actin-motility confusables lacking the Rac cycles.

qualifier: pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial ribosome assembly
rationale: Members share RNA modification (pseudouridine synthesis in rRNA, tRNA and mRNA, mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification) tied to mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial translation, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial tRNA processing, 3'-end processing and RNA stability.

core: cancer evasion of senescence and apoptosis
qualifier: CDKN2A (p16INK4A, p14ARF) or TP53 loss
name: Cancer senescence evasion via CDKN2A or TP53 loss
rationale: All members are cancer-associated defects in p16INK4A, p14ARF or TP53 that allow escape from oncogene- or oxidative-stress-induced senescence or apoptosis, unlike confusables describing normal senescence, TP53 regulation or RB1/CDK4/6 G1/S control.

qualifier: bilirubin and drug glucuronidation and SLCO/ABCC transport
name: Bilirubin and drug glucuronidation and organic anion transport
rationale: Members share hepatic disposal of organic anions: heme-to-bilirubin degradation, UGT glucuronidation and SLCO uptake/ABCC2 efflux (hyperbilirubinemias) plus drug ADME and xenobiotic transport, while confusables are CYP/sulfonation xenobiotic metabolism, bile-acid secretion or organic cation transport.

qualifier: E3-mediated chain assembly and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
name: E3 ubiquitin chain assembly and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
rationale: Members share ubiquitin conjugation by E3 ligases, covering atypical K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chains, monoubiquitination and the monoubiquitin-driven Fanconi crosslink repair pathway, whereas confusables emphasise deubiquitinases, proteasome and protein quality control.

qualifier: glycerol backbone metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
name: Glycerol metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members share glycerol-backbone metabolism (glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditols/fructose, PA, MAG/DAG/TAG synthesis, lysophospholipid hydrolysis) and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, unlike confusables centred on lipid-droplet and TG catabolism, endocannabinoids or PC synthesis.

qualifier: protein import, inner-membrane insertion and cristae organization
name: Mitochondrial protein import, membrane insertion and cristae organization
rationale: Members share building mitochondrial membranes: protein import into matrix, insertion into the inner membrane, outer-membrane organization, cristae formation, fusion and complex III assembly, whereas confusables cover OXPHOS function, mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or calcium import.

qualifier: negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and differentiation
name: Inhibition of myoblast proliferation and muscle differentiation
rationale: All members are negative regulation of muscle development at myoblast proliferation, myoblast/myotube differentiation and tissue/organ level, distinguishing them from confusables about positive myogenesis, satellite-cell maintenance or muscle atrophy.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-12, IL-17 and IL-1 families, Th17 and barrier
name: IL-10, IL-12, IL-17 and IL-1 family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members share signaling and production of IL-10-family (IL-10, IL-20 family, type III interferon), IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35), IL-17/Th17 and IL-1-family (IL-33/36/38) cytokines with epithelial wound responses, whereas confusables centre on common-gamma-chain/NK cytokines, Th2/mast cell and IL-6 signaling, or fungal C-type lectin responses.

qualifier: control of viral replication, transport and release
name: Host-virus control of viral replication, transport and release
rationale: Members share host and viral regulation of the viral life cycle after entry (genome replication, viral protein levels, transport, release and invasion suppression), distinguishing them from interferon/ISG15 antiviral signature confusables and viral-entry confusables.

qualifier: keratinocyte and melanocyte proliferation-differentiation control
name: Keratinocyte, hair follicle and melanocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members share control of epidermal and appendage growth (keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, hair follicle cycling, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation, nail and sebaceous gland development), whereas confusables cover ectodermal placodes, cornification/barrier formation or tooth development.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 (IPAF) inflammasomes, IL-18
name: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes, pyroptosis and IL-18 signaling
rationale: Members share canonical AIM2/IPAF inflammasome activation, pyroptotic cell death and IL-18 production/signaling, distinguishing them from caspase-4/5 non-canonical inflammasome confusables and NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing confusables.

qualifier: progenitor division, neurogenesis and neuronal migration in forebrain, midbrain, cerebellum
name: Forebrain, midbrain and cerebellar neurogenesis and neuronal migration
rationale: Members share brain-region development through neural progenitor division and maintenance, neuron specification (cortical, dopaminergic, granule), radial/tangential migration, cortical layering and commissure formation, unlike confusables focused on retina or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: purine de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Purine nucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members are purine-specific: PRPP and de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, salvage (HPRT1, APRT) and catabolism (ADA, PNP, allantoin, NUDT hydrolysis) plus thiopurine handling, whereas confusables cover pyrimidine metabolism and nucleoside/nucleobase transport.

qualifier: degron, ribosome-stall and aggregate clearance with stress granules
name: Ubiquitin-dependent clearance of misfolded, aggregated and ribosome-stalled proteins
rationale: Members share protein quality control by degradation: N-/C-degron pathways, ribosome-associated quality control of stalled nascent chains, ERAD regulation, aggresome/aggrephagy and stress-granule dynamics, while confusables emphasise E3/K48 ubiquitination regulation, chaperonin folding or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative stress
name: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative stress transcriptional responses
rationale: Members share oxygen/redox-sensing transcription factor control: HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1alpha target expression and hypoxia signatures, plus NFE2L2 regulation, degradation and its antioxidant, metabolic and inflammatory targets, unlike confusables on ROS detoxification/ferroptosis, p53/mTOR metabolic genes, FOXO or BACH1.

qualifier: resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of FLT3 mutants
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific tyrosine kinase inhibitors (quizartinib, gilteritinib, crenolanib, sorafenib and others), separating them from KIT/PDGFR resistant-mutant and FLT3 signaling confusables; the FLT3 confusable C1 differs only by a different inhibitor set (midostaurin, sunitinib, pexidartinib), which has no clean biological label.

qualifier: prostanoid and leukotriene receptors via PLC/IP3
name: Prostanoid and leukotriene receptor signaling via PLC and calcium
rationale: Members share GPCR signaling through phospholipase C, IP3/phosphoinositide synthesis and calcium, with prostanoid, prostaglandin D and leukotriene receptors as the ligand classes, distinguishing them from S1P, histamine and P2Y receptor confusables and leukotriene synthesis confusables.

qualifier: myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber, reactive gliosis
name: Myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members share glia-axon support: CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance (oligodendrocyte progenitors, Schwann cell initiation), neurofilament-based axon diameter, and astrocyte migration/reactive gliosis, unlike confusables on axon regeneration, glial fate specification or nodal sodium-channel clustering.

qualifier: branchiomotor neuron migration, facial and trigeminal nerves
name: Branchiomotor neuron migration and facial-trigeminal nerve development
rationale: Members share development of hindbrain branchiomotor circuits: tangential migration and axon guidance of branchiomotor neurons and formation of the facial and trigeminal nerves, distinguishing them from sensory cranial/otic, general brainstem/cerebellar and olfactory/GnRH confusables.
